slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (1) at the beginning of each of the three years, or is it restricted to only the first year?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks about the multi-year investment timing for project (1), matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 20% annual profit from project (1) paid out each year without the principal being returned, or is the principal also returned at the end of the investment period?
slot_scores.rationale: Asks about principal return timing, a related cash-flow issue, but does not explicitly ask whether proceeds can be reinvested the following year.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 150% total return from project (2) received as a single lump sum at the end of the third year, or is it paid out in installments over the three years?
slot_scores.rationale: Queries the timing of the project (2) return but offers end of year 3 or installments; does not confirm the end-of-year-2 recovery.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (3) at the beginning of each of the three years, or is it restricted to only the first year?
slot_scores.rationale: Asks about timing restriction but suggests first-year restriction instead of the actual second-year-only window; touches the slot but misses key meaning.

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (4) at the beginning of each of the three years, or is it restricted to only the first year?
slot_scores.rationale: Asks about timing restriction but suggests first-year restriction instead of the actual third-year-only window; touches the slot but misses key meaning.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The entire amount (principal + profit) from project (1) can be reinvested the following year.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly asked about reinvestment; the user simulator volunteered this fact in response to a question about principal return, and the agent treated it as confirmed in the ready-to-model summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while several P1 slots were only partially addressed: reinvestment rule (H2) was never explicitly asked, and project timing slots H3-H5 were queried with incorrect year options, leaving the specific recovery/investment windows unconfirmed by the agent's questions.

summary: The agent recovered the project (1) multi-year timing, but only partially addressed the project (1) reinvestment rule and the specific recovery/investment windows for projects (2)-(4), often suggesting incorrect year options and relying on volunteered information. It stopped prematurely with unresolved P1 slots and silently assumed the reinvestment rule.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
